title: A tiny change. A critical consequence.
text: A tiny warning change can leave the wrong label in production. Watch Aegis Label FX catch the mistake before release.

title: A working labeling assurance platform
text: This working prototype connects fictional devices, approved source versions, and controlled artwork. The demonstration uses synthetic data and a bounded ruleset.

title: 01 / Detect the source change
text: An approved specification adds: inspect packaging before use. The impact engine identifies two dependent labels and leaves unrelated products unchanged.

title: 02 / Generate, then challenge the draft
text: The studio generates revised artwork from the current source. I deliberately replace its warning with the older wording, creating a faulty revision.

title: BLOCKED / Safety warning mismatch
text: Validation blocks the draft. The expected warning, observed content, rule identifier, and source revision are inspectable. An unchanged warning can still violate a new requirement.

title: 03 / Correct and validate
text: Regenerating from the approved source corrects the artwork. Passing these checks makes it eligible for independent review. Passing never approves a release.

title: 04 / Independent reviewer approval
text: A separate reviewer account inspects and approves the exact revision. Approval binds the artwork hash, source version, and ruleset. Later artwork changes require fresh approval.

title: 05 / Download a traceable release
text: The release package contains actual SVG and PDF artwork, source evidence, validation findings, reviewer approval, and a release timestamp.

title: 06 / Test whether the controls work
text: Mutation Lab separately injects twenty four realistic faults into isolated copies. The detection results come from executed checks, including missing warnings and stale approvals.

title: Evidence, decisions and artwork hashes
text: The audit chain links evidence, decisions and artwork hashes. Verification detects edits, but hash chaining alone does not provide immutable storage.

title: Two public sources. Preserved provenance.
text: For research context, two public FDA datasets are joined by explicit product code. Six devices produce eight category matches. Restricted terminology and contact details are excluded.

title: AI proposes. Rules decide. Humans approve.
text: The interface uses Meta originated React, with an implemented Meta Llama API adapter. This recording uses deterministic mode. Educational prototype. AI proposes. Rules decide. Humans approve.
